You need to update the Setup Checklist Banner component in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app._index.tsx`.

The current SetupChecklist component needs to be redesigned to match this exact Notion spec:

**Design from screenshot:**
- A compact banner card with a settings/gear icon on the left
- Title: "Setup checklist — X of 3 steps done" (bold)
- A blue progress bar below the title
- Steps displayed inline (horizontal), not vertical:
  - Completed steps show: "✓ Created your first quiz · ✓ Mapped products to answers" (green text, inline with dot separators)
  - Pending step shows: "○ Publish your quiz to go live" (grey/subdued text)
- "Finish setup →" button on the right side (outline/secondary style)

**Behavior rules:**
- **Appears when**: There is at least one quiz but it has NOT been fully published
- **Step 1**: "Create your first quiz" — ticked green once a quiz exists
- **Step 2**: "Map products to answers" — ticked green once at least one product is assigned
- **Step 3**: "Publish your quiz" — shown as pending action
- **CTA**: "Finish setup →" — takes merchant to the quiz builder for the most recent draft quiz
- **Dismissed when**: All 3 steps are complete (banner disappears automatically)
- **Progress bar**: Shows visual percentage (e.g. 2 of 3 = 66%)

**Technical requirements:**
1. Read the current file first
2. Only modify the `SetupChecklist` function component — do NOT touch any other parts of the file
3. Use ONLY Polaris React components from `@shopify/polaris` — no Tailwind, no custom CSS frameworks
4. Minimal inline styles only where Polaris doesn't cover it (e.g., for the gear icon circle)
5. The component should use Polaris `Card`, `InlineStack`, `BlockStack`, `Text`, `ProgressBar`, `Button`, `Box`, `Icon`
6. Use `@shopify/polaris-icons` for the settings/gear icon — import `SettingsIcon` from `@shopify/polaris-icons`
7. Add the `SettingsIcon` import at the top of the file if not already imported
8. Keep the same props interface: `{ quizCount, hasProducts, hasPublished, onFinish }`
9. The banner should NOT appear if quizCount is 0 (no quizzes yet — show nothing, they haven't started)
10. Make sure the build passes: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap" && npm run build`

Write the code changes now.
